build_dynamic_stereo_model: build a DynamicStereo model with configurable max_disp, attention_type, and 3D update blocks for stereo depth estimation
run_forward_disparity_estimation: run the forward pass to estimate optical flow and disparity between left and right image pairs in a video sequence
run_forward_batch_test: run forward_batch_test on a batch of stereo video frames with sliding window kernel for disparity prediction
review_forward_sst_block: review the forward_sst_block method that applies positional encoding, self-attention, cross-attention, and temporal attention to feature maps
test_convex_upsample: test the convex_upsample method that upsamples flow fields using softmax-weighted convex combination of neighboring values
